primary: Separate follow-up cohort and hypothesis family: compare full vs no_blocks and full vs random_init within each workload. HV7 using exactly the previous scaling. Six structured founders or six random admissible genotypes (feasibility screened by decoder), two endpoints each and 148 subsequent evaluations.
